Risk desks learn to sit still

By Ana Example

NEWS-BODY-MARKER-1 The opening paragraph of risk desks learn to sit still.

Desk heads described the same pattern: the losses that hurt most came from trades that were right on paper and wrong in timing, closed in a hurry by people who could not sit still.

Several firms now rehearse quiet days the way pilots rehearse failures, with a checklist for what not to do when the screens go red and the phones start ringing at once.

The models changed little over the decade, one risk officer said; what changed was how long traders were willing to wait before acting on what the models already told them.

None of the firms would say what the rehearsals cost, and none would say what they saved.
